title: Legacy Single Pool Element
description: Variant of single_pool_element used for legacy-format structure files. Same field set as Single Pool Element; differs only in how the underlying structure file is interpreted.

fields.title: Element Type
fields.description: Must be 'minecraft:legacy_single_pool_element' for this element variant.

fields.title: Location
fields.description: Path to the structure template file, relative to the behavior pack's structures folder.

fields.title: Processors
fields.description: Identifier of the processor list to apply to this element, or an inline processor configuration. Optional.

fields.title: Projection
fields.description: How the element projects onto terrain.

choices.title: Terrain Matching
choices.description: Placed relative to terrain height; blocks adjust along the Y axis to match the ground.
